issues.description: Farm.addAnimal return type is inconsistent with the specification/UML: the problem statement UML defines `addAnimal(animal: Animal): boolean`, but the provided solution implements `public void addAnimal(Animal animal)`. Students following the UML may implement a boolean-returning method, which will not match the reference implementation (and may fail signature-based grading).
issues.suggestedFix: Align all artifacts to one signature. Preferred: change implementation to `public boolean addAnimal(Animal animal) { return animals.add(animal); }` (and update template accordingly). Alternatively, change the UML/spec to state `addAnimal(...): void`.
